integrity: The full proof establishes an analytic asymptotic count. Independent audit has not been conducted; reproducibility tests corroborate only finite instances.
scientific_limitations: Only a pulse-initialized, linear zero-temperature two-mode optical charger with loss on the charger; no subsequent drive.
Peak-count asymptotics require fixed coupling above the resonant threshold and detuning approaching zero; exponentially weak extrema may not be experimentally resolvable.
No claims for finite-time measurement resolution, nonlinear charging, direct battery damping, thermal noise, or non-Markovian dephasing.
title: Detuning turns perpetual pulsed-cavity recharge oscillations into a finite sequence
